method: Viewed actual PNG screenshot artifacts returned by the native file service.
findings: Desktop experiment form, plots, physical/modal readings and downloads are visibly separated and readable.
390px lab forms, diagrams, plots, tables and download controls stay contained in one-column cards.
360px invalid state visibly labels unapplied inputs, keeps the last applied results and disables observation controls.
390px learner question displays the imported title, all four choices and four concepts without clipping.
390px completed learner review displays 15 of 16 first-try connections, the one deliberate miss, all 16 review entries and notes controls.
limitations: Full-page screenshots supplement measured DOM geometry; they are not a physical mobile, touch or screen-reader test.
Screenshots capture specific reviewed states rather than every possible interaction.
